items.t: **DOPE SHEET** — the standing status page for one BOLO. Header: DOPE SHEET N. Vernacular: "give me the dope on N." "Status report" and "the situation on N" read the same. OPORD retired.
**Implied retired** from DARKROOM's dress axis; its opposite gets a value and a bench (below). Goes into vocab.json when DARKROOM is idle, then zeroshot rerun and retrain.
**"Caught up" reserved** — a phrase you like, held in the pool for something other than the cancel word. INTEL sits there too.
**The word for a rejected term:** you did not like "struck"; the bench for it was cancelled in the same breath. "Retired" (already SOP §5's word) is used from here.
**ADORNED ruled** ("let's do adorned"); applied on "vocab go": vocab edited, zero-shot rerun, probes retrained.
**ABORT ruled** — the cancel word, spoken three times: "abort abort abort", then the correction. First live use the same minute, on the ENDEX. Belay retired.
**BREVITY ruled** — what the SOI holds; the subtitle on every page. "The lexicon" and "the house tongue" gone.
**HOTLINE ruled** — the operator's callsign, detached from the person: casual "word from Hotline", formal **HOTLINE ACTUAL** on the net and on every rail. "You" retired from the pages.

**The close-out word, ten** (ENDEX collides with "index"): LIBERTY CALL (the call that the working day is over, go ashore) · SECURE (secure from quarters, secure the net) · KNOCK OFF (knock off ship's work) · LIGHTS OUT · TAPS · TATTOO · COLORS · CLOSE THE NET · STAND DOWN · LAST CALL. Sealed: LIBERTY CALL · SECURE · KNOCK OFF.

items.t: **Papi** — every word. **Claude** — the benches, the recommendation, the sealed ranking, the records.

entries.t: "I do not like the word OPORD… something much cooler." Bench ordered.
Bench delivered: DOPE (rec) · TARGET FOLDER · CONOP · JACKET · INTSUM · DOSSIER · CONTRACT · BRIEFING · CASEFILE.
"I like dope. BOLO 42 DOPE SHEET. Get me the dope sheet." Ruled. Also: a better cancel word than belay; "caught up" reserved; implied retired, its opposite to be named; BOLO 48 opened for the bench.
DOPE SHEET 48 built; cancel-word and dress-state benches delivered.

"Something better than the lexicon, give me ten. Vocab go. Disregard or cancel works but cooler, not break contact. Let's do adorned." Then: "I don't like you being it… SPACECOM, CENTCOM, CYWAR… BOLDCOM… Jason Bourne type."
ADORNED applied; three benches of ten delivered; ACTUAL on the rail provisionally; sheet layout fixed (calls to the left column).

"The cancel word to be abort, three times in a row… I do like brevity better… my callsign can be actual, but… HOTLINE; HOTLINE ACTUAL in communications." Then: "abort abort abort the index process… let's figure out the proword for that."
Three rulings written to SOP, the register and every page; the close-out bench of ten delivered.
Break-break: "the house, I don't like the word the house. Give me something NASA or Marine encoded. Give me like 10 examples."
Bench of ten delivered in chat and on this sheet: six Marine, four NASA; COMMAND recommended, PROGRAM second, MAGTF third. Bonus: "organic" becomes "organic" (the Marine word for assets a unit owns).
COMMAND written into SOP §5 and the SOI; the rename pass run; the retired-term names (the house tongue) and creator houses left as history.
